description: Gap themes raised by curation and the changes that addressed them.

themes.title: Product lumps (C5+, C5-C11, C2-C4 olefins) have no target concept
themes.decision: schema change (additive, provisional): ProductLump label, SUBSET_OF edge, selectivity-sum check reads containment
themes.motivating_records: Issue 39: 79 lump nodes in 14 FTS documents, each a ChemicalSpecies with species_kind other; on Cheng Cat-12h the sum check warned 191.8 % because C5-C11, C10-C20 and C21+ lie inside C5+.

concepts_considered.ChemicalSpecies (species_kind other, sco: kept for single identities; a lump has no formula, and the carbon window and class would stay free text, so no comparison or containment check
concepts_considered.value qualifiers (target, basis): carry which lump a value is for, but need a node to point at with a range and a class
concepts_considered.ChEBI classes: give a compound class but no carbon window; may fill compound_class later, no identifiers invented here
